# Copilot Instructions

Follow the repository-wide guidance in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Consult [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](../ARCHITECTURE.md) for design rationale and [`BOOT.md`](../BOOT.md) for runtime configuration. Keep provider integrations behind typed adapters, preserve the distinction between route and yes/no decisions, keep updates concise, and run `python -m pytest` after Python changes.
